study type: Pre-clinical experimental study (animal model and in vitro testing)
outcome: antimicrobial activity (against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli)
cohort: The study utilized wistar rats with excisional wounds for in vivo testing and bacterial pathogens (Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli) for in vitro antimicrobial activity testing.
finding: The hybrid nanocomposites containing CeO2-based chitosan and ZnO nanoparticles achieved nearly 100% wound closure in wistar rats after 2 weeks, significantly outperforming the control group which showed approximately 65% wound closure.
